title: Loud Structure Chests
description: You are not a quiet thief... or maybe?
body:
You are not a quiet thief... or not?

Thanks to this mod
every mob (specified in the config)
will react aggressively to **any** interaction with the **any** generated chests

Do you want the warden to literally see where you are for a moment?
["minecraft:warden"]

Do you want villagers to take revenge for you stealing their stuff?
["minecraft:villager"]

Do you want cows and sheep to bite you for this?
...
**YOU CAN!**



You can adjust the radius at which specific mobs can see you

and you can set the mobid of **any mobs** you want them to react to

aaand how many seconds do they be aggressive


*This mod was made for the SurviveTech Renewed modpack
but feel free modpackers with this mod <3
